# Media Object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MediaObject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An image, audio, or video media file — a concrete published artifact. A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Example Snippets

These snippets are generated from canonical slice examples and trimmed to the Turtle blocks where this term appears.

### Photo Metadata

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/images/examples/photo-metadata.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/images/examples/photo-metadata.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-images-examples-photo-metadata)#example-slices-extensions-images-examples-photo-metadata

```turtle
# --- The image. A MediaObject is a Manifestation on the WEMI spine, so it embodies
#     an Expression realizing a Work (the same backing every published artifact has).
ex:photo a gmeow:MediaObject ;
    rdfs:label       "Team portrait, June 2026"@en ;
    gmeow:embodies   ex:photoExpression ;
    gmeow:hasExifTag ex:exifMake , ex:exifDate ;
    gmeow:hasRegion  ex:faceRegion .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a concrete image, audio, or video file — the published media artifact that carries pixel dimensions, a MIME type, a capture time, a transcript, or a depiction.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the abstract work the media realises (that is a [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)) and avoid it for a non-media web page ([`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md)); the colourspace reference frame should be carried where known ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Type the file [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md), set [`gmeow:mediaType`](../properties/gmeow-mediaType.md) plus pixel/orientation/capture metadata, carry the colourspace frame via [`gmeow:colourspace`](../properties/gmeow-colourspace.md), and record subjects with the flat [`gmeow:depicts`](../properties/gmeow-depicts.md) (promote to a [`DepictionUsage`](gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) relator when context matters).

### Examples

- ex:photo a [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md); [`gmeow:mediaType`](../properties/gmeow-mediaType.md) "image/avif"; [`gmeow:pixelWidth`](../properties/gmeow-pixelWidth.md) 4032; [`gmeow:depicts`](../properties/gmeow-depicts.md) ex:lillith.
